# Scribd
> Scribd is a digital document library and subscription platform for discovering, reading, and sharing specialized knowledge across 300M+ documents.

Scribd organizes user-uploaded and curated documents across academic, professional, technical, and personal-interest topics, with browsing by subject, subcategory, and individual document pages.

## Core Platform
- [Home](https://www.scribd.com): Main entry point for discovering Scribd’s document library and platform features.
- [Upload a Document](https://www.scribd.com/upload-document): Upload interface for contributing documents to the Scribd library.
- [Explore Documents](https://www.scribd.com/docs): Top-level document discovery hub organized by subject areas and categories.
- [Search](https://www.scribd.com/search): Search interface for finding documents, topics, and specific titles.
- [Subscriptions](https://www.scribd.com/subscription): Subscription information for accessing Scribd’s document library.
- [Login](https://www.scribd.com/login): Sign-in page for accessing saved documents and account features.
- [Sign Up](https://www.scribd.com/signup): Account creation page for new Scribd users.

## Education & Test Prep
- [Study Aids & Test Prep](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Study-Aids-Test-Prep): Collection of study guides, summaries, and exam preparation materials.
- [College Entrance Exams](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Study-Aids-Test-Prep/College-Entrance-Exams): Test prep resources for college admissions and entrance examinations.
- [Book Notes](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Study-Aids-Test-Prep/Book-Notes): Literature notes, summaries, and study support materials.
- [Homework Help](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Study-Aids-Test-Prep/Homework-Help): Academic support documents for assignments and subject review.
- [Study Guides](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Study-Aids-Test-Prep/Study-Guides): General study materials for coursework and independent learning.
- [Test Prep](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Study-Aids-Test-Prep/Test-Prep): Broad exam preparation resources across subjects and levels.

## Science & Mathematics
- [Science & Mathematics](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Science-Mathematics): Broad collection of science, math, and technical learning documents.
- [Biology](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Science-Mathematics/Biology): Biology notes, research materials, and educational documents.
- [Chemistry](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Science-Mathematics/Chemistry): Chemistry study resources, lab materials, and reference documents.

- [Mathematics](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Science-Mathematics/Mathematics): Math documents covering theory, exercises, and instructional content.
- [Astronomy & Space Sciences](https://www.scribd.com/docs/Science-Mathematics/Astronomy-Space-Sciences): Astronomy and space science resources for study and reference.
